content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B. Tech in Electronics & Communication Engineering/ Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering from any Institute / University. Experience: At least 25 years with expertise in both planning and execution of projects across TV, Radio, Satellite, DTH broadcasting and OTT systems etc. Age limit: Maximum 63 years (as on 30 September 2026) Other conditions: Retired ex-Prasar Bharti officials (Chief Engineer level and above) who retired from PB within the last 2 to 3 years. Candidates should be in sound health (both physically and mentally), should not be accused in any pending inquiry and should be of impeccable integrity. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who were previously engaged by BECIL and whose services were terminated, discontinued, or not renewed on account of disciplinary action, misconduct, unsatisfactory performance, or violation of contractual terms

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially for a period of 1 Year to begin with, extendable further based on requirement and satisfactory performance.

content_sections.heading: How Will BECIL Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications based on credentials & suitability Interview in physical/virtual mode for shortlisted candidates Screening-cum-Selection Committee meeting Interview in physical/virtual mode

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: All relevant certificates and testimonials in original along with one set of self-attested photocopies

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BECIL Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit https://becilregistration.in to complete online registration process. Fill personal details in new registration and register. Proceed on other details and payment to complete application submission. Save the application receipt after successful payment. Apply on or before 2 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No allowance such as DA, Residential Telephone, Transport Facility/Transport Allowance, HRA, CGHS, Medical reimbursement etc. is admissible. The application processing fee once paid shall be non-refundable and non-transferable under any circumstances.
